survey.what_is_it: a local-first, deterministic music-theory engine for 12-TET pitch material (Python package `mts`). Recognizes and contextualizes scales, chords and pitch-class sets, and increasingly time-bearing material. The destination is a FOUNDATION LIBRARY with an MCP endpoint so agents can turn varied notations into enriched, contextualized datasets — not an end-user app (see README, CLAUDE.md).

architecture_rung.earned_by: one WRITING dev thread, plus three read-only/verifying parallels that have each caught real defects the dev thread missed: the audit loop (own git worktree, files GitHub issues, checks fenced into audit/checks/ — see audit/AUDIT.md), the C++ port thread in a sibling repo which never edits mts/ and whose parity harness has corrected us (the macos-14 libm ruling), and read-only research swarms. Rung 3 is NOT claimed: nothing but this thread writes the engine, and the ~15x multiplier is unearned while a single integrator keeps up.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: every piece of pitch-class arithmetic and its consequences: bitmask/set-class math, interval vectors, exhaustive subset and containment search, symmetry, key induction and its versioned profiles, cadence/function mapping, ruleset conformance evaluation, constraint search, conformance repair, and every generative transform (conform, remap, modal). The engine's reason to exist is doing exactly the combinatorics LLMs are bad at; fuzzy/semantic reasoning lives in the CALLER, above the MCP boundary. No model calls exist inside `mts` and none will.

oracle_shape.goldens: tests/golden/conformance.json (one deterministic case per MCP tool, TOTAL coverage enforced — a new tool without a case fails), tests/golden/tool_manifest.json (the rug-pull gate: every tool's name + signature + FULL docstring, so a description edit lands as a readable diff), port/pin.json (fingerprints the ported surface so engine drift from the C++ port fails here)
oracle_shape.ci: two legs — `pytest tests/` and `pytest audit/checks/` — across Python 3.10 + 3.13. `./verify fast` runs the dev suite; `./verify full` adds the audit leg and scripts/ci-local.sh, which reproduces both legs on both interpreters and reports honestly (loud WARN) which it could not reproduce.

survey.second_implementation_note: tonality-core (C++), Decision 10 — dual implementation, golden-anchored. Parity is byte-for-byte against this engine's export; port/pin.json + tests/test_port_pin.py fail here when the engine drifts from the ported surface.

consumes: versioned priors from citable theory (key profiles, melodic tendency, GM percussion, structural-key thresholds) — never corpus-fit, always version-stamped
